infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CTL uses your location to find nearby service centers and repair shops, for example showing the closest oil change or tire shop near you.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CTL uses the camera so you can take photos of your vehicle, receipts, and damage to attach to maintenance and fault log entries — for example, snapping a photo of an oil change receipt or a check engine warning light.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CTL accesses your photo library so you can attach existing photos to maintenance records, fault logs, and vehicle profiles — for example, selecting a previously taken photo of your car's odometer or a service invoice.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: CTL saves generated reports and exported photos to your photo library so you can keep records of your vehicle's history.

plugins.calendarPermission: Allow CTL to add service reminders to your calendar.
